L87: 
L88: The Goethe-Institut is the Federal Republic of Germany’s cultural institute, active worldwide. We promote the study of German abroad and encourage international cultural exchange.

L111: 
L112: Diverse. Open to all.
L113: 
L114: Our library in Yaounde is a place for everyone who wants to read, listen to music, watch films, be inspired and meet people. We look forward to seeing you from Monday, June the 16th!

L135: ## Our offer
L136: 
L137:   * ### 【55†Translation programme】
L138: 
L139: Our translation funding programme supports the publication of books by German authors in another language.
L140: 
L141: 【58†Image】
L142: 
L143:   * ### 【56†Service for librarians】
L144: 
L145: Events, specialised information and cooperation services for librarians.
L146: 
L147: 【59†Image: Service für Bibliothekare Goethe-Institut Kamerun】 © Bernhard Ludewig / Goethe-Institut
L148: 
L149:   * ### 【60†BibToGo】
L150: How about having all services of our library at your fingertips, anytime and anywhere? This is now possible with our digital membership app BibToGo!
L151: 
L152: 【61†Image: Digital membership card】 © Goethe-Institut Indonesien
L153: ## Our projects
L154: 
L155:   * ### 【62†L’aprèm’ du livre】
L156: 
L157: L'aprèm' du livre is the monthly book presentation organised by the Goethe-Institut Cameroon.It enables authors to present their works to a broad public and to enter dialogue with the audience.
L158: 
L159: 【63†Image: l'aprèm du livre 】 © Goethe-Institut Kamerun
L160: 
L161:   * ### 【64†Library as Professional Hub】
L162: Through the Library as Professional Hub programme, the library provides young people, students, job seekers, and project leaders with an environment that promotes career discovery, professional skills development, and access to useful resources for building their future.
L163: 
L164: 
L165: 【65†Image: Library as Professional Hub】 ©Goethe-Institut Kamerun
L166: 
L167:   * ### 【66†Studying in Germany: How-to videos】
L168: Yulu is a young high school graduate who would like to study in Germany. To find out more, he researched online to find out how to go about it. Among other information channels, he takes part in one of the many online information sessions offered by German universities.
L169: 
L170: 
L171: 【67†Image: viedoexpl695】 ©Goethe-Institut Kamerun
L172: 
L173:   * Comic art
L174: ### 【68†AFRICOMICS】
L175: 
L176: Artists from 14 African countries meet in workshops and create a new (comic) world together! Discover new perspectives, learn more about African comic art in videos and follow the creation of new stories!
L177: 
L178: 
L179: 【69†Image: Africomics】 © Mosab Zakaria
L180: 
L181:   * ### 【70†Cameroon-German History】
L182: Between 1884 and 1916 the territories of Cameroon were part of the German Colonial Empire.
L183: The Goethe-Institut Kamerun supports acitivities that help to bring more light into this episode of common history.
L184: 
L185: 【71†Image: Kamerunisch-deutsche Geschichte】 © Goethe-Institut Kamerun

L110:   * # Lending
L111: 
L112: In our library you will find books, magazines, films, music, apps and games in German. Our translated titles also offer non-German readers the opportunity to learn about literature, culture, society, politics and current affairs in Germany. Another focus is our collection of German as a foreign language. In addition, there are media for children and young people.
L113: 
L114: 【54†Image: Students】
L115: Students | Photo: Lena May
L116: ## Registration and library membership
L117: 
L118: The library is open to the public and the access to media is free of charge. A valid membership card is required to borrow media. You must therefore register personally in the library.
L119: ### Registration
L120: 
L121: To be a member of our library, you need to fill in this 【55†registration form†yaounde.bibliothek.goethe.de】 on our website.
L122: You will receive a confirmation email. All you have to do is come by within the next 7 days with your ID to finalise your registration and pay the fees in cash (if applicable) according to our 【56†price list】.
L123: We look forward to welcoming you!
L124: ### Membership and fees
L125: 
L126: In principle, the consultation printed media in the library are free of charge. Annual subscription is required for loans as well as the use of audiovisual media in the library. Subscription costs between 5,000 and 10,000 F CFA.
L127: It is possible to make photocopies and printings in the library in accordance with copyright regulations. Prices as well as terms and conditions can be consulted on our price list.
L128: 
L129: 
L130: 【57†User regulations(PDF, 4 MB)】
L131: ### The Digital Library Card BibToGo
L132: 
L133: What about having all the services of our library at your fingertips, anytime, anywhere? 【58†The app BibToGo†play.google.com】 combines all the benefits of your library membership. And offers even more!
L134:   * You receive a personal digital library card integrated in 【58†BibToGo†play.google.com】. With this digital card, you can borrow media from our library. Even if you are offline.
L135:   * With 【58†BiToGo†play.google.com】 you can conveniently access your personal library account and view your borrowed media, extend the loan period or check media reservations.
L136:   * Would you like to see which media we have in our stocks? With 【58†BibToGo†play.google.com】 you can easily access our library catalogue. Our lists with selected media recommendations will help you make your selection.
L137:   * Looking for additional information on how to best benefit from our collections? An integrated QR code reader allows you to access additional information when you are in our library.

L151: The majority of the media in the library can be borrowed. A self-check-out system is available in the library. The self-checkout terminal can only be used with a valid library card.
L152: ### Lending periods and extensions
L153: 
L154: A maximum of 2 media can be borrowed.
L155: The lending period is 2 weeks.
L156: It is possible to extend the loan period. Items can be renewed once for a further 2 weeks, provided they have not been reserved.
L157: 
L158: ### Preorders
L159: 
L160: Borrowed titles can be pre-ordered online in the OPAC, on site or by email.
L161: We will notify you as soon as they arrive. Pre-ordered media will be held for you for one week.
L162: ### Return of media
L163: 
L164: The media can be returned during the opening hours of the library.
L165: Please treat all media with care and do not underline or make any entries in the books. The borrower is liable for damage or loss. Borrowers are responsible for compliance with copyright regulations.

L188: ## Consult the librarian!
L189: 
L190: Employees in the libraries of the Goethe-Institut are not just booke keepers.
L191: They are also competent interlocutors in relation to your research. Through this form, you have the possibility to ask questions about Germany. There are no limits to how detailed your questions can be.For legal reasons, we are not able to provide legal and health information.
